'''''Lal Tip''''' (''The Red Point'') is a 2012 [[romance film]] directed by [[Swapan Ahmed]] and produced by [[Impress Telefilm Limited]] and Benani Films. The film stars [[Mamnun Hasan Emon|Emon]] and [[Kusum Sikder]] in lead roles. The film was released worldwide on 17 February 2012.<ref name="dd16Feb2012" /><ref>{{cite news |title=Swapan Ahmed on his movie Lal Tip |url=http://newagebd.com/newspaper1/archive_details.php?date=2011-11-20&nid=40697 |work=[[New Age (Bangladesh)|New Age]] |date=20 November 2011 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130706174752/http://newagebd.com/newspaper1/archive_details.php?date=2011-11-20&nid=40697 |archive-date=6 July 2013 |access-date=2 July 2013 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Production ==
The film was produced by [[Impress Telefilm Limited]] and Banani Films.<ref name="dd16Feb2012">{{cite news |script-title=bn:কাল মুক্তি পাচ্ছে লাল টিপ |url=http://www.dainikdestiny.com/index.php?view=details&type=main&cat_id=1&menu_id=67&pub_no=73&news_type_id=1&index=13&archiev=yes&arch_date=16-02-2012 |language=bn |newspaper=Dainik Destiny |access-date=2 July 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402105006/http://www.dainikdestiny.com/index.php?view=details&type=main&cat_id=1&menu_id=67&pub_no=73&news_type_id=1&index=13&archiev=yes&arch_date=16-02-2012 |archive-date=2 April 2015}}</ref>

=== Filming ===
Shooting locations included [[Paris]], [[Bangkok]], and [[Dhaka]]. Some shots were taken in [[India]]. The cast filmed in Bangkok and [[Cox's Bazar]], where Emon and Kusum Sikder also shot a romantic song. 50% of the shots were done in [[France]], and the rest were done in [[Thailand]], [[Bangladesh]], and India.

=== Casting ===

[[Mamnun Hasan Emon]] was the first to sign into the film and was under Swapon Ahmed's direction for the second time. Kusum Sikder was signed to play the female lead, as Swapon Ahmed wanted a fresh face for his movie.

== Soundtrack ==

The soundtrack was composed by [[Fuad al Muqtadir]]. Two songs, ''Beshe Jai'' and ''Hariye Jawa Sapne'', were released with the trailer. The promo video for all the songs was released on 27 December 2011. [[Samsung]] organized the film's music launch on 25 December 2011.<ref>{{cite news |script-title=bn:‘লাল টিপ’ ছবির গান নিয়ে মিউজিক ব্লাস্ট |url=http://www.mzamin.com/details.php?nid=Mjk3&ty=MA |language=bn |newspaper=[[Manab Zamin]] |access-date=2 July 2013}}</ref> The music was composed by Fuad al Muqtadir, Ibrar Tipu, and Arefin Rumey. Three-time Academy Awards winner Morris Jar composed one song for the album.

== Marketing ==

Samsung and [[Channel i]] announced their association with Impress Telefilm Limited for their film ''Lal Tip''.<ref>{{cite news |title=Laltip music launched thru' concert |url=http://news.priyo.com/film/2011/12/27/laltip-music-launched-thru-con-44627.html |newspaper=Daily Sun |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304055255/http://news.priyo.com/film/2011/12/27/laltip-music-launched-thru-con-44627.html |archive-date=4 March 2016 |access-date=2 July 2013 |via=Priyo}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title='Lal Tip-Samsung Music Blast' held |url=http://www.dhakamirror.com/uncategorized/lal-tip-samsung-music-blast-held/ |newspaper=Dhaka Mirror |date=27 December 2011 |access-date=2 July 2013}}</ref>

== Release ==

''Lal Tip'' was released worldwide on 17 February 2012. A red carpet premiere of Lal Tip was organised by Impress Telefilm on 15 February 2012.<ref>{{cite news |title=Lal Tip: highlighting Bangladeshi tradition through expatriates |url=http://newagebd.com/newspaper1/archive_details.php?date=2012-02-16&nid=50500 |work=[[New Age (Bangladesh)|New Age]] |date=16 February 2012 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130706174725/http://newagebd.com/newspaper1/archive_details.php?date=2012-02-16&nid=50500 |archive-date=6 July 2013 |access-date=2 July 2013 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |author=Hafez Ahmed |date=17 February 2012 |title=Nationwide release of Lal Tip today |url=http://www.daily-sun.com/details_yes_17-02-2012_Nationwide-release-of-Lal-Tip-today_58_1_7_1_0.html |newspaper=[[Daily Sun (Bangladesh)|Daily Sun]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402193506/http://www.daily-sun.com/old_version/details_yes_17-02-2012_Nationwide-release-of-Lal-Tip-today_58_1_7_1_0.html |archive-date=2 April 2015 |access-date=2 July 2013 |url-status=dead}}</ref>
